title: Text to Image
detail: Enter a prompt, choose an image model, check the price, then run. No input file is needed.

title: Text to Video
detail: Enter a prompt, choose a video model and duration, check the price, then run. No input file is needed.

title: Image Editing
detail: Choose an image in Load Image and describe the edit. Select a model, check the price, then run.
footer: Upload an image · Describe the edit

title: Image to Video
detail: Choose a starting image in Load Image, describe the motion and select a model. Check the price, then run. No image-generation step is needed.

title: First & Last
Frame to Video
detail: Choose the starting and ending images in the two Load Image nodes. Describe the transition, choose a model and check the price before running.

title: Reference
Images to Video
detail: Choose a reference image in Load Image, or connect an image batch for multiple references within the model limit. Add a prompt, check the price, then run.

title: Video Editing
detail: Choose your video in Load Video and describe the edit. Select a model, check the price, then run.
footer: Upload a video · Describe the edit

title: Audio to Video
detail: Choose an audio file in Load Audio and describe the video. Select a model, check the price, then run.

title: Make a
Portrait Talk
detail: Choose a portrait in Load Image and speech or singing in Load Audio. Check the price before running.

title: Transfer
Motion
detail: Choose the subject image in Load Image and motion-reference clip in Load Video. Select a model, check the price, then run.

title: Create, Then
Animate
detail: Choose the image and video models and edit both prompts. The image output feeds the video node. Both stages are billed separately. The video price button cannot execute the image node; a generated reference must already exist for a manual video quote.

title: Create, Then
Animate
detail: This compatibility starter uses fixed Seedream 4.0 image generation and Pruna Video animation nodes. Review both prompts and spending caps before running. Use choose-model-image-to-video for model selection and the Check price buttons.
